dedupe_keys.name: leolabs low earth orbit visualization catalogue and conjunction platform

description: LeoLabs runs a platform for tracking objects in low Earth orbit with its ground-based radars. Its public Explore LEO section offers a 3D low Earth orbit visualization, the LEO catalogue with a catalogue search, today's conjunctions (close approaches between objects), the instrument sites and system metrics. Signed-in users get fleet management, tracking and monitoring, collections, operational ephemerides, safety of flight tools (conjunction search, 3D conjunction views and on-demand screening), tasking requests, orbit analytics, proximity views and launch tracking, and the documentation covers a command-line interface, an API, embeddable maps and ephemeris file formats. Access to the explore pages is free online under the LeoLabs terms of use; the operational services need an account, and their cost was not stated on the page read. Caveats: LeoLabs is a commercial provider, the visualization loads by script, and the catalogue covers low Earth orbit only. Coverage is global low Earth orbit. It supports hazard exposure analysis of collision risk to satellites that power communications, positioning and Earth observation services; related records are the EU SST services and the CONAE space object re-entry reports.
